senses.gloss: Middle High German 'ervarunge', meaning 'journeying through' or 'exploration'
senses.note: Derived from Middle High German ervarunge, also meaning journeying through or exploration. Wiktionary, CC BY-SA 4.0.

senses.gloss: Derivation from the verb stem 'erfahren' with the suffix '-ung'
senses.note: Formed as a derivation from the stem of the verb erfahren using the derivational suffix -ung. Wiktionary, CC BY-SA 4.0.
